An 80-second track for the camera test.

Start at recording time 10 seconds.

On your iPhone, select External speaker and start the camera recording. When its timer reaches 10 seconds, play this file from the beginning through the external speaker.

The first 10 seconds are silent. Six tones (40, 80, 160, 320, 640, 1280 Hz) repeat twice, with pauses. For the muted control, mute this playback device and repeat the same actions.

Download the original WAV ↓

Keep the playback device off the test table so pressing Play does not move the recording iPhone. No microphone or camera is requested by this player page.
